name: Hosts Inspector Reachability Finding
description: An account's footprint in one region hosts an Amazon Inspector v2 network-reachability finding (footprint -> finding): one inspector2:ListFindings returned for the run's account, ACTIVE or CLOSED in the last 30 days, each read capped at 1,000 per region. Containment, parent -> child: the footprint declares this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, and the reader records that footprint's account_region.inspector2_reachability_findings surface, filtered and capped, so never complete. The finding is also the middle node of a compound edge, which retires it with either end. Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/inspector.py (aws-core-tap#261).
